notes: Ten localized movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of the upper sink cabinet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although both transitions occur within the same sparsely sampled intervals and their exact ordering is ambiguous.
scene_description: A person traverses a compact apartment kitchen and adjacent living area, sequentially opening and closing a clothes closet, several kitchen appliances and storage parts, both refrigerator compartments, and a laundry closet.
